messages.text: I’m checking whether the temperature estimate includes the full ASIC-to-coolant path and the sensor-leakage path. I’ll also inspect the final native result and the sensitivity-gate correction.

**DES043-PhysVal-06 — reviewed `476826f6b369a34d9fef08e56cfae5dfcdcda32e`.**

**The −22.163 °C value is not a complete maximum-sensor-temperature estimate.** Its downstream resistance model lacks a named ASIC bond contribution, while the graphite leakage-corner allowance does not cover upstream sensor/bump/redistribution resistance.

The explicit 50 µm ASIC glue layer over two 23.4 mm square tiles gives, assuming full bonded area and **κ ≥1.2 W/(m·K)**:

\[
R_\text{bond}\leq\frac{50\times10^{-6}}
 {1.2\,[2(0.0234)^2]}
=0.03804758\ {\rm K/W}.
\]

Absorbing this into the existing **0.04 K/W** contact budget would leave only **0.00195242 K/W** for all other interfaces. That is mathematically possible only with an explicit demonstrated residual budget; it cannot be silently assumed. I recommend retaining the 0.04 allowance and naming the bond separately.

The proposed **additional upstream leakage-path requirement ≤0.5 K/W** adds **1 K** at 2 W leakage. Define it as additional to the separately counted bond; if it includes that bond, explain the deliberate conservative double counting. This is a design requirement to establish, not a measured or derived feasible resistance.

Charging the bond conservatively with all module heat gives:

\[
T_\text{screen,new}=T_\text{screen,old}
 +(P_\text{electronics}+2\,{\rm W})R_\text{bond}
 +(2\,{\rm W})(0.5\,{\rm K/W}).
\]

| Scenario | Revised conditional temperature |
|---|---:|
| Nominal | **−23.812209 °C** |
| Adverse | **−20.332651 °C** |
| No-power-scaling stress | **−13.373536 °C — fails** |

The adverse margin is only **0.333 K**. Describe this as a **conditional lumped thermal screen under specified resistance, bonding and coolant bounds**, without claiming qualified maximum sensor temperature. Effective bonded area, upstream heat spreading, contacts, irradiation and leakage feedback remain unverified.

Alternatively, retain −22.163 °C only with a clearly restricted downstream/spreader-side interpretation. It should not remain labeled as the complete sensor maximum.

**The sensitivity-gate correction is confirmed.** The `181cdc0..476826f` diff adds actual sensitivity/expected-role agreement, exact sensor-name/count checks and rejection of an empty identifier population. I ran all **eight portable native tests**, plus independent empty/missing/duplicate/unexpected-sensor controls; all passed.

I also inspected the actual final native report and verified its bindings:

- **792 actual sensitive sensors and unique volume IDs**
- **3,960 cell checks**
- **7,200 window/contact probes**
- **Zero recorded overlaps or errors**
- Source and generation revision **476826f…**
- All eight source fingerprints matched Git and current bytes; compact, materials, expected-record and library hashes matched.
- Engineering status correctly remains **UNQUALIFIED**.

Report SHA256: `0fb7ff8a28564c8237c5f162096c938853f4f3ea635701d8ae1d8d0607fef8a5`.

No native execution or repository edits were performed by me. Adding these explicit thermal requirements does not change the geometry; preserve the native report at its actual revision rather than relabeling it as a later thermal calculation. No qualification or human acceptance is granted.
